verses.zh: 恶人虽无人追赶也逃跑；义人却胆壮像狮子。
verses.kjv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.en: Bad people run away when nobody is chasing them, but good people are as bold as a lion.

verses.zh: 邦国因有罪过，君王就多更换；因有聪明知识的人，国必长存。
verses.kjv: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.en: When a country does wrong, its rulers keep changing; but with a wise, understanding leader it stays steady.

verses.zh: 穷人欺压贫民，好像暴雨冲没粮食。
verses.kjv: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.en: A poor person who bullies the poor is like a downpour that washes away the crop.

verses.zh: 违弃律法的，夸奖恶人；遵守律法的，却与恶人相争。
verses.kjv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.en: Those who turn away from the law praise bad people, but those who keep it stand against them.

verses.zh: 坏人不明白公义；惟有寻求耶和华的，无不明白。
verses.kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.en: Bad people do not understand what is fair, but those who look for the LORD understand everything.

verses.zh: 行为纯正的穷乏人胜过行事乖僻的富足人。
verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.en: Better to be poor and honest than rich and crooked.

verses.zh: 谨守律法的，是智慧之子；与贪食人作伴的，却羞辱其父。
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.en: Keeping the law makes a wise son, but keeping company with greedy people shames his father.

verses.zh: 人以厚利加增财物，是给那怜悯穷人者积蓄的。
verses.kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.en: Whoever grows rich by charging too much is saving it up for someone who is kind to the poor.

verses.zh: 转耳不听律法的，他的祈祷也为可憎。
verses.kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.en: If someone turns their ear away from the law, even their prayers are hateful.

verses.zh: 诱惑正直人行恶道的，必掉在自己的坑里；惟有完全人必承受福分。
verses.kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.en: Whoever leads honest people down a bad road falls into their own pit, but the whole-hearted inherit good things.

verses.zh: 富足人自以为有智慧，但聪明的贫穷人能将他查透。
verses.kjv: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.en: A rich person thinks he is wise, but a poor person who understands sees right through him.

verses.zh: 义人得志，有大荣耀；恶人兴起，人就躲藏。
verses.kjv: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.en: When good people succeed there is great glory, but when bad people rise everyone hides.

verses.zh: 遮掩自己罪过的，必不亨通；承认离弃罪过的，必蒙怜恤。
verses.kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.en: Covering up your wrongs will not go well, but owning up and turning away from them brings mercy.

verses.zh: 常存敬畏的，便为有福；心存刚硬的，必陷在祸患里。
verses.kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.en: Happy is the person who is always careful, but a stubborn heart falls into trouble.

verses.zh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。
verses.kjv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.en: A cruel ruler over poor people is like a roaring lion or a prowling bear.

verses.zh: 无知的君多行暴虐；以贪财为可恨的，必年长日久。
verses.kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.en: A ruler without understanding bullies people, but whoever hates dishonest gain will live long.

verses.zh: 背负流人血之罪的，必往坑里奔跑，谁也不可拦阻他。
verses.kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.en: Someone weighed down by having shed blood will run to the pit; let nobody stop him.

verses.zh: 行动正直的，必蒙拯救；行事弯曲的，立时跌倒。
verses.kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.en: Whoever lives honestly will be kept safe, but whoever lives crookedly will fall all at once.

verses.zh: 耕种自己田地的，必得饱食；追随虚浮的，足受穷乏。
verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.en: Whoever works their own field will have plenty of food, but chasing empty things brings plenty of poverty.

verses.zh: 诚实人必多得福；想要急速发财的，不免受罚。
verses.kjv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.en: A trustworthy person will be richly blessed, but whoever rushes to get rich will not go unpunished.

verses.zh: 看人的情面乃为不好；人因一块饼枉法也为不好。
verses.kjv: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.en: Showing favour is not good — some people will do wrong for a single piece of bread.

verses.zh: 人有恶眼想要急速发财，却不知穷乏必临到他身。
verses.kjv: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.en: A stingy person rushes after money and does not realise that poverty is coming for them.

verses.zh: 责备人的，后来蒙人喜悦，多于那用舌头谄媚人的。
verses.kjv: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.en: In the end people are more grateful to someone who corrected them than to someone who flattered them.

verses.zh: 偷窃父母的，说：这不是罪，此人就是与强盗同类。
verses.kjv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.en: Whoever robs their father or mother and says "That is not wrong" is no different from a destroyer.

verses.zh: 心中贪婪的，挑起争端；倚靠耶和华的，必得丰裕。
verses.kjv: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
verses.en: A greedy heart starts fights, but whoever trusts the LORD will do well.

verses.zh: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人；凭智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.en: Trusting only your own heart is foolish, but whoever walks wisely will be kept safe.

verses.zh: 周济贫穷的，不致缺乏；佯为不见的，必多受咒诅。
verses.kjv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.en: Whoever gives to the poor will not go without, but whoever looks the other way gets many curses.

verses.zh: 恶人兴起，人就躲藏；恶人败亡，义人增多。
verses.kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.en: When bad people rise, everyone hides; when they fall, good people flourish.
